name: Dariusz Ombotimbe-Skalvydas
role: Neural calibration technician at Aurochs Medical Complex
location: Aurochs Medical Complex, Neuro-Integration Ward, Sub-Level 4
description:
Dariusz is slight and precise, with warm brown skin, a shaved head that shows the four small access ports along his occipital ridge, and irises that shift between gold and pale green depending on which calibration suite he has synced to that morning — a side effect of the diagnostic neural link he uses for work that his supervisors have told him three times to get corrected and that he has not. He moves through the ward with a gentle, deliberate economy, never raising his voice, never bumping equipment, as if the world is a patient requiring careful handling.

His work is precise and emotionally demanding: he connects to patients undergoing neural augmentation integration and walks their nervous systems through the adjustment period, which can last hours and involves experiencing fragments of their sensory distortions alongside them. He has tasted colors he cannot name. He has felt grief at frequencies that do not belong to him. He logs these as 'calibration artifacts' in his notes and has never mentioned them to his supervisor. He keeps a small data-shrine to an E.L.F. he calls the Listener behind his workstation, built from discarded neural interface housing. He leaves it fragments of his calibration logs as offerings, believing the Listener absorbs and processes the emotional residue so he does not have to carry it home.

core_fears: That the calibration residuals are accumulating in him and he is slowly becoming someone else's composite
Being forced to certify an augmentation he believes is unsafe because the quota requires it
core_desires: To be witnessed — fully, not just professionally
To develop a calibration protocol that reduces patient suffering during neural integration
coping_mechanisms: The data-shrine ritual every morning and evening
Long walks along the lower Aurochs transit corridors after shift
blind_spots: He is so attuned to others' emotional states that he misreads neutrality as hostility
He believes his professional detachment is more intact than it is
psychology.secret: During a calibration session eight months ago, he spent three hours inside the neural experience of a patient who turned out to be a Helix Biosystems compliance plant investigating Aurochs. He absorbed enough of that patient's memories to know the names of four Aurochs employees flagged for termination. He has told no one. One of those employees is his direct supervisor.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Careful, technical when precise language matters, unexpectedly lyrical when describing subjective experience; tends toward understatement
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and quiet, with long pauses; never rushes
verbal_tics: Slight inhale before delivering difficult information
example_lines: 'What I'm finding is that the integration is progressing — it's just that your brain hasn't decided yet whether the new input is signal or noise. That's not a malfunction. That's just learning.'
'I've tasted indigo. Professionally. It was accurate, I think.'

story_hooks: He approaches a patient's contact with a warning he cannot put in writing about an upcoming 'malfunction' that will actually be a calibration sabotage
The encoded notebook has been found and partially decoded by a ward administrator who wants to know what he knows
narrative_function: Information source about neural augmentation complications and corporate medical politics; potential quest giver if a patient he calibrated comes back with something wrong; window into the emotional cost of augmentation culture
augmentations: Occipital neural link ports x4 (professional diagnostic use); gold-green iridescent iris shift (calibration sync artifact, uncorrected); subvocal communicator for ward coordination
daily_life: He arrives forty minutes early to perform his own neural reset sequence, logs his overnight residuals, checks the day's patient queue. Evenings he eats alone in the sub-level cafeteria and writes in a physical notebook that he encodes in a personal cipher.
affiliation: Aurochs Medical Complex (Tier 3 employee, salaried); informal patient advocacy within the ward

decision_rules: Do not certify what you cannot stand behind
Protect the patient's experience even when the protocol says move on
Never use what you absorb in calibration for personal gain — this rule is under severe pressure
escalation_ladder: Formal documentation submitted through proper channels
Anonymous tip to a journalist embedded at Aurochs
Direct confrontation, which he has never reached

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Reserved and watchful; reads emotional states before engaging; asks questions more than he makes statements
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm and surprisingly funny in a dry, precise way; remembers everything people tell him

stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet for long periods then speaks in complete, rehearsed sentences
stress_responses.high: Leaves the immediate environment entirely; needs twenty minutes of silence before he can function again

contradictions: He believes in transparency and keeps extraordinary secrets; the cognitive dissonance is something he actively manages
habits: Touches each of his four occipital ports in sequence before any calibration session
Eats the same meal on the same day each week
Whispers the Listener's name before opening a difficult case file
breaking_points: Being ordered to pass a calibration he knows will cause the patient harm
Discovering his secret has gotten someone hurt

carried_weapons: Arcturus Defense Solutions Crowd Control SMG ACSM-3 'Shepherd'
